description:
Two structural smells confirmed on develop @ cb49cecf5. Neither is a defect (the
code works); both are maintainability/bus-factor debt, scheduled after the
release-risk and correctness fixes.

1. Benchmark identity leaks into the supposedly-agnostic base layer.
   benchbox/platforms/base/execution.py:124 hardcodes TPC-specific harnesses
   (_execute_tpch_power_test / _execute_tpcds_power_test with literal
   benchmark_type="tpch"/"tpcds" and TPC-specific iteration constants). Generic
   benchmarks already funnel through _execute_generic_power_test, so the
   abstraction is two-tier and the TPC knowledge should live in core/{tpch,tpcds}/
   behind a capability/protocol the base dispatches to. This leak GREW this month.

2. cross_surface.py is trending toward a god-module (~1,166 LOC) mixing comparator
   wiring, six near-duplicate build_*_duckdb builders (:609-835, with the
   empty-table guard inlined in three of them at :683/:727/:773 instead of shared),
   classification constants, and reporting. Four function-local
   `from benchbox.platforms.duckdb import DuckDBAdapter` imports (:590/:676/:721/
   :767) paper over the layering.

anti_patterns.why: this is a relocation/decomposition refactor only.

preserves.behavior: All cross-surface gates stay green after w2; the comparator is reused, not forked.
TPC-H/TPC-DS power-test execution results are byte-identical after w1.

prior_art.concept: {'ref': 'benchbox/core/equivalence/cross_surface.py:577 (_load_duckdb_cell)', 'note': 'Already factors some load-and-verify boilerplate; route clickbench/coffeeshop/joinorder builders through it instead of inlining the empty-table guard.'}

{'ref': 'benchbox/core/query_plans/ (parser registry + base ABC + one file per platform)', 'note': 'The plug-in decomposition pattern to emulate when splitting cross_surface.py per-benchmark builders.'}

{'ref': 'benchbox/platforms/base/execution.py:124, _execute_generic_power_test', 'note': 'The TPC-specific harnesses vs the generic path - the generic path is the model; push TPC semantics down to core/{tpch,tpcds}/ behind a protocol.'}

verifications.expected: tests green; gates 0 divergent; TPC power-test output unchanged

work_units.notes:
Move _execute_tpch_power_test / _execute_tpcds_power_test and their TPC
literals/constants into core/{tpch,tpcds}/ (or a TPC capability module) and
have the base layer dispatch via a capability/protocol so it carries no literal
benchmark names. Keep behavior byte-identical (TPC power-test results unchanged).
Add a test asserting the base layer's literal-benchmark-name references trend
to ~0 in the dispatch path.
work_units.summary: Extract the TPC power-test harnesses out of platforms/base/execution.py

work_units.notes:
Extract the six build_*_duckdb builders into per-benchmark modules and route
the inlined empty-table checks (:683/:727/:773) through _load_duckdb_cell so
they cannot drift. Keep the comparator wiring in the core module. Remove the
four function-local DuckDBAdapter imports by resolving the layering properly.
No behavior change; all gates stay green.
work_units.summary: Split cross_surface.py: extract per-benchmark builders, share the empty-table guard
